# MD View 1.0.0-rc.2

The third public release candidate of MD View: a native Markdown, text, and code editor for
Windows, macOS, and Linux, built with Rust and egui. No webview.

## Highlights

- **Split view ends together.** With scroll-beyond-last-line on, the split editor no longer
  scrolls its last row to the top and goes blank while the preview shows the end of the
  document. Zoom or resize at the end keeps both panes at the new end, and split sync now lands
  exactly on its target.
- **The editor has focus when you need it.** Entering Editor or Split mode, switching tabs, and
  closing find or go-to-line give the editor keyboard focus; arrow keys, typing, and copy/paste
  work without clicking the text pane first.
- **Insert LaTeX Block.** `Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+M`, **Edit → Insert LaTeX Block**, or the command
  palette inserts a `$$` display-math block on its own lines with the cursor inside.
- **Steadier editor end.** Both editor scrollbars stay allocated, so the maximum scroll offset no
  longer oscillates at the end of a document in Edit and Split.
- **Alt keys stay out of the text.** Alt menu keys and the conflict keys `Alt+R`/`Alt+K` no longer
  leak their letter into a focused editor (a reloaded file is no longer marked dirty again).

Everything from 1.0.0-rc.1 and 1.0.0-rc.0 is included: flicker-free split view, GitHub Markdown
parity, Oniguruma highlighting, the explorer that follows tabs, and the desktop packages.

## Install

Download the asset for your platform and verify it against `SHA256SUMS`:

| Platform | Preferred asset |
|---|---|
| Linux | `MD-View-1.0.0-rc.2-x86_64.AppImage` |
| Debian / Ubuntu | `mdview_1.0.0.rc.2_amd64.deb` |
| Fedora / RPM | `mdview-1.0.0.rc.2-1.x86_64.rpm` |
| macOS | `MD-View-1.0.0-rc.2-macOS-arm64.dmg` |
| Windows | `MD-View-1.0.0-rc.2-windows-x86_64.msi` |

The macOS and Windows RC builds are **unsigned**. Gatekeeper and SmartScreen may ask for an extra
confirmation. Signing and notarization remain final 1.0.0 release-operator steps.

Documentation: https://jigonzalez930209.github.io/md-view-rs/

## Checksums and SBOM

The release includes a combined `SHA256SUMS`, `latest.json`, and `sbom.cdx.json`. Use
`sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` on Linux/macOS or `Get-FileHash` on Windows.

Full changelog: https://github.com/jigonzalez930209/md-view-rs/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
